title: Compile Procedures into Reliable Offline Execution Plans for Sovereign Local Models
target_platform: Apple Silicon M1 (16GB) MLX runner; forge_llm.py; procedure_executor.py; 8 GiB RAM ceiling
hypothesis: A finite-state executor using typed procedure steps, with the local sovereign model restricted to bounded decisions, will: (a) complete >= 90% of held-out procedure tasks; (b) improve success by >= 15 percentage points over the frozen MISSION-022 free-form loop; (c) execute zero operations outside the declared tool contract; (d) use <= 70% of the free-form baseline inference tokens; and (e) remain within 8 GiB measured process-tree memory with incremental swap <= 1 GiB.
falsification_criteria: Any required threshold missed falsifies the hypothesis. Success achieved by adding task-specific hardcoded answers to the executor does not count as generalization. If deterministic-only execution matches performance without the model, the LLM component is falsified.
experiment: Define six procedure families: repository discovery, schema migration planning, evidence collection, test triage, snapshot validation, and recovery diagnosis. Use 20 development cases and 60 held-out instances. Compare free-form local execution, compiled procedures plus local decisions, and deterministic-only execution.

model_routing.frontier_escalation_condition: Frontier models are restricted to development-phase pipeline implementation only (ceiling 150k cloud tokens).

related_missions.MISSION-022: FOLLOW-UP TO: replaces falsified unconstrained free-form agent loop with a deterministic FSM framework.
related_missions.MISSION-021: CONSUMES: relies on local structured JSON function calling and tool contracts.
related_missions.MISSION-028: COMPLEMENTS: establishes local operational envelope before routing escalations to cloud models.

resources: local-model-memory (8 GiB limit); max 12 local inference-hours, 150k dev tokens
projected_impact.basis: Declared 2026-11-04 upon intake of Astra candidate N04. Refine at checkout and confirm with `manage_coordination.py verify`.
